interface.signature: def isScramble(S1: str, S2: str) -> bool

preconditions.description: Both S1 and S2 must be strings.
S1 and S2 must have the same length.
The length of S1 and S2 must be between 0 and 31 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S1) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S2)
preconditions.description: Both S1 and S2 must consist of lower-case English letters.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if S2 is a scrambled form of S1, otherwise False.
